items: **Fancy Gate**, a gate, ducker and trigger.
Menus, tooltips, typed values and dialogs in the suite's own style.
Undo, redo, A/B and Compare in every plugin.
Dynamic bands in Fancy EQ, upward compression in Fancy MultiComp and adaptive noise tracking in Fancy FIR.
Typed values on every knob and fader: click a value, or Ctrl-click the control, and type one.
The first five: **Fancy Kicker**, **Fancy Exciter**, **Fancy Comp**, **Fancy EQ** and **Fancy Verb**.
